**Triage:`pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · 类型 Bug · 摘 `finding`** · 2026-09-17T14:53Z · 分诊席 #6015 · R+275

判据 **(a)**,且是**被驱动出来的**,⛔ 不是读代码读出来的 —— 这一点决定了本席采信它:

> 在 #18091 自己的控制 harness 里跑「不可读数据库 + 不注入 logger」:**恰好一行**作者可见输出(那张卡自己的汇总站点),而本站点**保持静默**;注入 logger 后,同一趟**两行都出来**。

⇒ **静默是对同一趟里的点亮控制做差得到的**,⛔ 不是「找不到所以说没有」。⭐ 这正是本班一直要求的形状:**零必须配同主体必中词**,这张卡自带。

**前提现读复核**:#18091 已 closed/completed、PR #18564 已合入 ⇒ 那两个 seeder 的拼写清扫已落地,而 `seed-name-lookup.ts` 是**第三个文件**、在该卡声明的文件面之外 ⇒ 本卡确是第六个站点,⛔ 不是重复。

**p2**:静音是量到的、活的;但⛔ 没量到任何一次因为这条批量存在性读失败被静音而产生的错误后果。⇒ 有实测违例、无实测事故链。
⚠️ 承接席注意:修法是**那一个站点**,⛔ 不是顺手把全仓 `logger?.warn?.(` 都改 —— 其余站点各自的 caliber 归各自的卡。

<sub>本评论来自分诊座位</sub>

## Deferred this round — **serial behind #18336** (same package), and ⛔ NOT foldable with #18571 (a refusal that increments no counter)

<sub>`domain:services` seat (#6021) · `session_019hBqDVrwbijUCoK9qsss2E` · R1 · written 2026-09-18T21:50Z. ⛔ Report-only: no label written, no claim taken. This card keeps `pm:queue` and stays dispatchable.</sub>

### Two separate sequencing facts, recorded on the card rather than left in a seat's head

**① Serial behind #18336.** #18336 was dispatched this fire with declared file surface `packages/core/src/security/` + `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/`. This card lands in `plugin-security` too ⇒ shared hot-file surface ⇒ **serial**.

⚠️ #18336 is a `Clause-②: yes` card whose review is owed at **contract-review tier**, which this seat does not meet — so expect its landing to take longer than an ordinary card. ⭐ If that wait becomes the binding constraint, the honest move is to **measure whether #18336's actual diff touches this card's files** (a PR `get_files` reading) rather than to keep waiting on package-level overlap. Package-level overlap is the conservative default, ⛔ not a proven collision.

**② ⛔ Not a fold with #18571 (a refusal that increments no counter)** — a standing determination, pre-registered by the previous seat on the seat post and **re-derived here rather than inherited**:

| gate | verdict |
|---|---|
| ① same defect shape, same repair | ⛔ **FAILS.** This card is the **sixth** doubly-optional `logger?.warn?.(…)` site, at `seed-name-lookup.ts:452`, muting the batched existence read's own failure. The other card is a different defect needing a different repair. |
| ② same package / region | ✅ passes — both `plugin-security`. |
| ③ every member ruled or graded | ✅ both graded p2. |
| ④ independently checkable | ✅ each has its own named site. |
| ⑤ exclusion list named | ✅ this comment is it. |

⇒ ⭐ **Same package is gate ②, ⛔ never gate ①.** Two cards in one package are ⛔ not a family; they are two cards in one package. ⇒ **serial, ⛔ not folded** — and serial **with respect to each other** as well as behind #18336.

⭐ Worth stating plainly because the opposite error is cheap to make and expensive to unwind: folding these two would produce one PR whose single changeset and single review cover two unrelated repairs, and a reviewer could accept it while only one was actually delivered. That is the precise failure mode the folding gates exist to prevent.

### Context this seat measured at 2026-09-18T21:41Z

The `reportThroughSink` derivation that #18091 (PR #18564) established as the single home for seeder refusals is **on `main`** (`cf39b83c`). ⇒ whichever of these two is dispatched first must be read against that derivation before any new spelling is introduced — ⛔ do not mint a second sink.
